PHASE 4. Electrical ROUGH-IN AND TRIM OUT
Bonding wire attached to shell bonding studs
Equipotential bonding grid installed around perimeter
Equipment pad base/slab poured or set
Backfill material staged (crushed stone or flowable fill per manufacturer spec)
Begin filling shell with water (initial few inches)
Begin backfilling in lifts, alternating with rising water level
Compact backfill in lifts (hand tamp near walls; no heavy equipment against shell)
Monitor shell walls for movement/distortion throughout process
Continue matched lifts until backfill reaches grade and water reaches skimmer level
Verify shell walls are straight and true (no bowing)
Concrete collar/bond beam formed around shell perimeter (if required by design)
Pattern/material selected and approved by customer
Review Operation and Layout of Equipment with Installation Team
Auto Leveler and Pool Drain verification
Salt or Chlorinate Pool per startup schedule
